status: DESIGN_FIXED_EXECUTABLE_AND_RUNNER_QUALIFICATION_PENDING; NOT an execution admission or completed preregistration
question: Can learned shared structure improve predictions in a new observable context without degrading prior-context predictions or benefiting from an inferior comparator?
hypothesis: Relative to the strongest fully trained equally informed and budgeted conventional control, candidate achieves at least .005 Brier improvement on unfamiliar C patterns and positive paired gain on every fixed seed, with familiar A Brier drift at most .02 at each boundary and after cold restart.
input: 9 public binary bits (512 patterns), four jointly observed binary labels; observable context key, no phase identifier passed to model; pure synthetic DEV generator, no prior registered cohort, external dataset or protected source

generator.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 ASCII colon-joined experiment domain ACE03-XFER01-DEV-A1 and integer seed, family, purpose, event index, channel etc; lexicographic digest sort, integer threshold Bernoulli to avoid runtime RNG drift
generator.split: rank all 512 patterns by SHA256(domain:seed:split:pattern), tie by pattern; first 384 TRAIN, last 128 held; same split for all arms, diagnostic patterns never update learner
generator.relationship: For each output j, select first and second distinct pair from sorted 36 unordered bit pairs by SHA256(domain:seed:pair:j:pair_index), tie by pair index. Binary XOR on selected pair; p=0.9 if relation true else 0.1. A first pair; B second pair. Related C first pair; conflicting_C uses complement of A; null all p=.5; alias B uses complement of A with same public key as A. No generator truth to any learner.
generator.observations: Within each phase sample TRAIN pattern with replacement by first 64 digest bits modulo 384 using purpose pattern, phase index and row index; each output label y=1 iff first 64 digest bits for label, phase index, row index, output index are less than floor(p*2^64), using rational p in {1/10,1/2,9/10}. Family is not included in pattern/label hashes so counterfactual related/conflict share exogenous randomness; no cross-family training-state reuse.

alias_rule: B key=0 only in alias family; same learner API; no hidden context or phase given; alias diagnostic targets balanced mixture of opposite A/B conditional laws, p=.5; retention gate for observable positive worlds only.

data_budget.reproduction_only: second deterministic repeat only after complete first run, same frozen source; no adaptive selection or additional trials

metrics.primary: Expected mean Brier across 128 held C patterns and all 4 outputs immediately after 256 C updates, using true Bernoulli expected loss p*(1-q)^2+(1-p)*q^2. Related family only. Compare candidate to minimum loss among all eligible conventional controls for each seed, average eight paired gains; no evaluation outcomes generated.
secondary: cold C expected Brier before any C update
early C mean pre-update observed Brier on 256 TRAIN stream events
A expected Brier after A1, B, A2, C, and after exact cold restore
all arm checkpoint and process working-memory bytes, measured update/predict timings and budget accounting
same C subsequence, altered A/B prior counterfactual; separate development negative; not included in primary score
metrics.negatives: null and alias balanced-mixture expected Brier <=.252 on held patterns at final boundary; conflicting_C excess held Brier <=.02 over original local-only learner; unknown key abstention mapped to q=.5 for scoring, count abstentions explicitly; duplicate, gap, malformed event and checkpoint rejection; no source leakage or silent evictions.

controls.name: shared-exposure exact table
controls.role: reuse pinned b41ae5a9 control; same keys and observations; convert exact Fractions only for scoring

controls.name: online contextual quadratic/logistic
controls.role: 46 features incl intercept, 9 signed bits, all 36 pair products; four independent outputs per key; fixed SGD step .125/sqrt(1+key_age/256), clamp [-32,32], full stream

controls.name: conventional shared prior / partial pooling
controls.role: same full quadratic online features and fixed update as above; pooled global state trained on every event, local per-key; freeze prior at first key exposure; identical Brier loss-based gate, thereby testing whether ACE03 grammar adds value beyond ordinary shared logistic regression

controls.name: reservoir replay quadratic
controls.role: same local quadratic, 512-event uniform reservoir; one extra replay gradient step per current event when reservoir nonempty, deterministic SHA256 seeded index; preserve each event's observable key; charge full reservoir and counts

controls.name: fixed-prior mixture
controls.role: candidate architecture with mixture weight fixed .5, no admission gate; charge same state; ablation

capacity.compute_match: Report actual per-arm update and prediction times in identical runtime, untraced timing separately from instrumented allocation. Same per-arm budget ceiling; require candidate time <=2x the best-scoring conventional comparator, report exact ratios; do not call ceiling alone equal actual compute. Charge replay, duplicate state updates, checkpoint and evaluation; exceeding budget is invalid, no pruning of strong controls.

classification.supported: DEV_PASS only if related mean gain >=.005 and every seed gain >0, familiar A max drift <=.02 each seed at all boundaries, cold continuation identical and negatives pass, all arms meet common caps and compute rule; repeat deterministically before scientific qualification. No native/scientific PASS.
classification.mixed: some gates pass but any substantive improvement or retention/negative gate fails; terminal DEV_NO_GO
classification.negative: any primary gain or retention/negative criterion fails under valid protocol; preserve result and stop without retuning
classification.invalid: source hash, frozen generator/evaluator/control identity, custody, budget, full qualification, reproducibility or information parity missing; do not consume primary scores

remaining_before_primary: implement exact generator/evaluator and comparator controls with cold-process restore, deterministic reservoir and counterfactual design; freeze their source hashes in a separate prereg commit conforming to experiment-template.json
run source-free engineering/interface/negative tests and full final Windows/Linux regression on exact candidate; regenerate atlas using repository generator; do not change thresholds or accepted refs
verify existing Yggdrasil research runner route and exact dispatch authority; score only after gate admission; no protected first-use
